fields.label: Gateway URL
fields.description: Base URL of the OpenWA gateway, no trailing slash. Example: http://11.0.11.17:2785

fields.label: Session ID
fields.description: OpenWA session UUID (Sessions page or GET /api/sessions)

fields.label: Webhook Secret
fields.description: Shared HMAC secret for verifying incoming webhooks from the gateway

fields.label: Max Messages Per Minute
fields.description: Per session. Hard stop above this; 0 disables. Keep modest to protect the number from bans.

fields.label: Minimum Seconds Between Sends
fields.description: Per session. Short waits are applied automatically; 0 disables.

fields.label: Enable AI Auto-Reply
fields.description: Master switch. Only fires on unclaimed conversations for messages that don't match any escalation keyword below.

fields.label: Ollama URL
fields.description: Base URL of the Ollama server, no trailing slash. Example: http://11.0.11.35:11434

fields.label: Escalation Keywords
fields.description: Comma-separated. Any match anywhere in the customer's message forces escalation to a human - never sent to the AI. Leave blank to use the built-in default list.

fields.label: System Prompt
fields.description: Leave blank to use the built-in default. The model is instructed to reply with exactly ESCALATE when unsure - that response is caught and never sent to the customer.

fields.label: Escalation Acknowledgment Message
fields.description: Sent once, automatically, when a message needs a human (matched an escalation keyword, or the AI itself wasn't confident) and nobody's claimed the conversation yet. Leave blank to use the built-in default. Does not count as answering the customer - the SLA reminder/escalation timers keep running normally.

fields.label: Support Email Account
fields.description: The dedicated mailbox NexChat treats as a support inbox. Only Communications on this account become Email Conversations - everything else (invoices, quotations, other mail) is left alone. Also replies go out from this account. Leave blank to keep the email channel fully disabled.
